note: A writer and former New York Times and Slate editor argues that mathematics is not dying, seeing AI as a continuation of mathematicians' long use of computers. She says the novelty lies in how OpenAI conducted and promoted its work, without collaboration, conventional publication or attribution, and expects AI to complement human researchers if companies act transparently.
title: AI has come for writers, filmmakers, and artists. What about mathematicians?
who: Susan Rigetti (The Boston Globe, contributing opinion writer)
